name: Barracuda Cybersecurity Glossary
description: Barracuda Cybersecurity Glossary — vendor-published security terminology reference spanning email protection, data protection and backup, network security (SASE, SD-WAN, zero trust), application security (WAF, DDoS, API protection), endpoint/XDR, ransomware, and cloud security for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and public cloud. Aligned to Barracuda's product portfolio.
relationToCloudSecurity: Direct — substantial coverage of cloud email security, cloud WAF/application protection, and SASE/zero-trust networking terms relevant to protecting cloud and hybrid workloads.
relationToAISecurity: Indirect — Barracuda applies AI/ML to threat detection (spear-phishing, account takeover); the glossary may include AI-assisted-threat and detection terminology but is not AI-security-specific.

license.notes: Barracuda Networks copyright Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

current_extraction.notes: Enumerates /support/glossary/<slug> term pages from sitemap.xml; per page the <h1> (cleaned of SEO 'What is...'/subtitle cruft) is the term and the schema.org Article description is the definition. For the 14 pages with an empty Article description, the definition is AI-distilled from body prose (Claude, BARRACUDA_AI_MODEL). Curated tier is deterministic; the 14 AI definitions are best-effort.

scope.extraction_note: 159 terms (all sitemap glossary URLs) in the canonical {term, definition, source_anchor, notes} schema (glossary-terms.csv/.json). For 145 entries the definition is the page's curated schema.org Article description; for the 14 whose Article description is empty (marketing-promo-only pages), it is AI-distilled from the page body prose via extract_barracuda_glossary.py + Claude — recorded per-row in notes ('ai_distilled_from_body'). SEO-article <h1> titles are reduced to bare terms (e.g. 'What is cloud WAF: Use case and benefits' -> 'Cloud WAF').
